title: MailboxStatus
description: A short status one member of a pair epoch posts about one mailbox (POST /v1/mailbox/status), signed with that member's device key over JCS of every field but signature. role "recipient" is a delivery receipt for item `sequence` (ok, or the step that failed); role "sender" says whether the sender can currently send (ok clears an earlier problem). Codes come from a fixed list (constants.json mailboxStatus) and never carry content. Sides: catalog sender=sub, recipient=owner; rulebook sender=owner, recipient=sub; report sender=sub, recipient=owner. The relay keeps the latest status per (pair epoch, mailbox, role) by `at`, and returns it verbatim in the pair status so the other member verifies the signature itself.

deviceKeyId.description: The posting device; must be the pair epoch's device on `role`'s side of `mailbox`.

sequence.description: The item number the status is about (catalog snapshotId, rulebook version sequence, report sequence), or 0 when it is about no item. A recipient's sequence is never above the mailbox's last consumed item.
